reviews.comment: Dr. O'Farrell is one my favorite professors in the English department. You'll be reading a LOT for this class, but it's good stuff and she has amazing lectures. I find her funny, kind, engaging, and very knowledgeable about her topic. Would recommend!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Farrell is my favorite professor I have ever I had at Texas A&M. She is truly an expert in her field, and her lectures are extremely engaging because of it. She is a very tough grader, but as long as you do the readings and come to class, you should be able to understand everything. I 100% recommend taking any of her classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love Dr O'Farrell!! I have taken her for 3 classes and she is so kind and really gets to know her students on a personal level. You can tell she cares about us and is also really smart and knowledgeable in English. Take her if you want to learn and build good connections!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: “Lecture heavy” but it's basically a book club. You NEED to be vocal in the class and READ, she's good at bringing everyone out of their shell. 2 essay. Only 2 exams but all you do is choose 5 quotes given and annotate them, that's it. TAKE HER FOR AN EASY A! Attendance is extra credit if u go to EVERY class! She's funny and very kind!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: There are very few assignments (5 essays some short some long)in this class, so assignments are weighed heavily, but it was nice to have so few. We read 4 books all of which I really enjoyed. She is really a great professor who cares about her students. I love her and would love to take her class again!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I LOVED this class. Professor O'Farrell kept the class entertaining. The classes were primarily discussions on the readings and be prepared to read. There are pop quizzes but they are not really weighted. The exams were also fairly simple, it's not that hard to pass and she is a great grader. 100% recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof O'Farrell is a very sweet women who cares about her students. There were days when all students looked tired and she let us go home. She does assign lots of readings but as long as you show up to lecture prepared her class was easy and enjoyable. She grades hard so put in effort to your papers!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Inspirational--Caring

reviews.comment: Very one-sided opinions about text interpretation which is frustrating when she invites the class to discuss interpretations of the text. It is her interpretation or no interpretation. A novel she required us to read was graphically sexual and was not understanding when I asked for an alternate assignment due to my religion.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Farrell is the best professor I've ever taken. She is respectful, understanding, and sometimes brings snacks for the class. We only had a few essays, which were fine as long as you went to office hours for her to go over your rough drafts first. 10/10 would recommend!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr O Farrell is the best professor I ever had. She is not only sweet and understanding but funny and engaging. Due to having a hard time, she gave extensions if necessary and provided amazing feedback on previous essays which fostered growth. I will take another class with her as soon as possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Inspirational

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Farrell is amazing! I definitely recommend taking one of her courses. Her classes are typically discussion-based, but she is hilarious, making learning fun! There aren't many assignments, but she is accommodating and provides thorough feedback. The only "complaint" I have is that she takes a while to grade; apart from that, I adore her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I might have made a B in the course but the B has standard. She is  a scholar and expects perfection. I loved her course and class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I loved how her class is discussion-based but she goes through papers and finds every little thing she disagrees with and marks points off for it. Like having the title as "final paper" or disagreeing with the subject of the paper. It's unfair for the amount of work that we put into our papers. Don't take her unless you're okay with a C or D.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: While Prof Farrell was very kind, I got frustrated with her grading. We had three short essay exams, weekly short assignments and a final paper, at the end of the semester only the first exam grade was in. I don't know if there were extenuating circumstances, but it was frustrating to spend time on something without getting credit for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a GREAT professor. The readings can be kind of heavy, but the discussions are very accessible and she absolutely makes sure everyone is tracking. If we have trouble with the reading, she gives advice or additional time. There are exams as well as an essay, but it was all open book, over the course of a few days.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Caring

reviews.comment: This is the type of professor who makes you want to participate in class. She was really good about always acknowledging the comments people made and helping to bring them to the next level. She truly cares about her students
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Caring

reviews.comment: I love Prof. O'farell!! She is amazing!! So kind and genuine and keeps the lectures very conversational. She has random fun pop "quizzes" answering questions ranging from fav halloween candy? to are you a fan of musicals? I learn a ton in class and would highly recommend her!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Caring

reviews.comment: Best professor I've ever had. Make sure to go into office hours for papers! If you are willing to discuss your thoughts with her, she will be such a big help. There is a LOT of reading and papers/exams are challenging, but they're doable. Would take every class with her if I could!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She is truly one of the best professors I've ever had, and I don't say that lightly. She lectures incredibly, makes you think, and truly cares for her students' wellbeing. Once offered me an extension on a paper after I talked to her about how busy and stressed I was. Not only is her course interesting, but she is fun and kind. Lots of reading.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best English teachers I've had at A&M. She is very helpful inside and outside of class, she also cares a lot about her students.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Shes so real, and its really clear that she cares about the students actually learning and expanding our knowledge of the world.
reviews.ratingTags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Farrel is hands down one of the best English professors I've ever had. Although she assigned a lot of essays, she really helps you out with them and has detailed assignment sheets. Attending class isn't super important because you mainly only discuss the assigned reading, but it really helps to listen for the next essay you'll have to write.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Farrell's classes are really simple. Read the book, talk about the book, write a paper on the book. You really can't ask for a more strait-forward class. There wasn't much homework and the class discussions were interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: No tests, rarely ever gives homework. She assigns a lot of reading, and papers are long. Class is incredibly boring. Theres really no need to come because she just talks about whatever the latest reading is.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Farrell is hands down my favorite professor at A&M. I took her class on British Literature pre-1870, and it was extremely well taught and obvious that she was highly interested in the subject. She gave tons of great background information and insights on what we read. The tests weren't too bad at all; I would 100% recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. O'Farrell is brilliant and knows so much about the subjects she teaches. She is an expert in her field but is able to teach well too. There was more reading for this class than I've done in my life, but it is worth it for how much you learn! I'd definitely  still pick Dr. O as my prof for my senior seminar if I could do it over again.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor made me love English again. She links the lectures about the novels we read to our society and topics that are interesting to engage in. She is a really smart woman with a love for English. She will make you work for your grade, however it will make you a better writer. Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I have had the pleasure of taking Dr. O'Farrell for 2 classes. She is an amazing professor! We have to read a lot of novels, but she picks those that she believes we will enjoy-- and we do! Every class lecture is having an intellectual conversation about what we read the past night, and it's actually cool to see that she gets us engaged.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Without a doubt my favorite professor ever. She is simply wonderful. Hilarious, kind, helpful, and challenging, with the ability to take texts (in my case, those of Jane Austen) and bring them to life. We talked about books, films, pop culture, and everything in between. MAOF was a huge influence in my decision to pursue English in grad school.
